title: Timely Filing of an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Policy clause.** An Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) must be received by the payer within the payer class's timely-filing limit. A claim submission must be received no later than the timely-filing limit counted from the first date of service. Count calendar days starting the day after the first date of service; a claim received on the last day of the limit is timely. A front-end rejected submission never counts as received, so the clock keeps running from the date of service while the rejection is corrected. A replacement claim must also be received within the payer class's replacement-claim window of the adjudication or denial date, and no more than the payer class's maximum number of replacement claims are filed on one claim (counted as the corrections already filed on the claim). When a CO-29 timely-filing denial is received and Riverbend holds one of the accepted timely-filing proof documents showing an earlier accepted submission inside the limit, the claim is resubmitted with that proof (timely-filing proof attached); without such proof the denied amount is written off as timely filing expired and is never billed to the patient.

**The filing gate as the records show it**
- Evidence: the claim's first date of service, on the claim record itself (a system record; the patient's recollection of the date does not replace it).
- Clock: calendar days, counted from the day after the first date of service.
- Comparison: the receipt date must be no later than the last day of the limit; receipt on the last day itself is timely.
- Applies to: an original submission, a resubmission and a filed correction of that same claim.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical, on a 180-day limit)**
- First date of service on day 0: day 1 is the first counted day, so day 180 is the last day of the limit. A claim received on day 180 is timely.
- The same claim received on day 181 is not timely.
- A submission rejected at the front end on day 20 and corrected on day 185 was never received on day 20; the corrected claim on day 185 is past the limit.

**CO-29 denials**

| Proof held | Result |
|---|---|
| A clearinghouse acceptance report or payer acknowledgement letter showing an earlier accepted submission inside the limit | resubmit with the proof attached |
| No such proof | write off as timely filing expired; never billed to the patient |
